_help: Settings for make_short.py. Change words, formats and the daily schedule here; no code changes needed.

rotation._help: Which formats the daily run makes on each weekday (Central time). Formats: worth, guess, teams, snooze.

worth.sub: {n} games rated. No scores. No spoilers.
worth.title: Which {league} {when} games are worth watching? (No spoilers)

guess.pill: Comment your guess before it fills
guess.title: Guess the Thrill Score: {league} {when} edition

teams.sub: Ranked by average Thrill Score this season.
teams.pill: Is your team on the list?
teams.title: The most entertaining {league} teams to watch this season

snooze.sub: The least exciting game we rated.
snooze.pill: Don't say we didn't warn you
snooze.title: The most boring {league} game of {when} (No spoilers)
